study type: Critical reappraisal / Review of randomized controlled trials and prospective cohort study
exposure: Pharmacologic thromboprophylaxis (Low Molecular Weight Heparin - LMWH)
cohort: The studies reviewed included patients who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Pharmacologic thromboprophylaxis was not consistently associated with a significant reduction in VTE risk according to meta-analyses, but it was linked to an increased risk of bleeding and hematomas, leading to a suggestion for universal LMWH prophylaxis following c.d. despite higher costs due to the challenges of selective risk assessment.
mod_finding: The risk of Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) has been estimated to be 2-4-fold higher after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
